label: Onboarding
description: Account opening that is stuck or failing: notary, AOF and e-sign, PAN name mismatch, RFI or NSTP review, CBS customer creation, and RTL Part-1.
signals: notary will not connect or is stuck
notes: The largest group. Mostly multi-hop, and many cases match a known pattern. RTL is involved for Part-1 only. The Slack Tag often says Onboarding when the issue is elsewhere, so expect to re-route after the first lookup.

label: Auth: MPIN, session, device
description: The user cannot set, reset or use the MPIN, loses the session, or is blocked by a device check.
signals: MPIN reset or forgot MPIN fails
device binding or device security block
notes: Hard. The root cause is often in the mobile client or in another onboarding stage, which only code reading or a closer look at the account state shows.

label: Welcome letter, delivery and address
description: The welcome letter or other physical delivery was not sent, failed, or went to the wrong address.
notes: Usually a single lookup from SSFB harbor into ATSPL package, plus a vendor-wide scope check. Often ends in a request for a write such as a re-trigger, which triage recommends and never runs.

label: Outward transfers
description: An outward IMPS or NEFT transfer is stuck, failed, reversed or delayed.
signals: IMPS or NEFT transfer stuck in processing
notes: Medium. Two known rhythm bugs cover most cases. Money moved, so the reply must say whether the money is safe.

label: Inward funding and remittance
description: Money sent into the account, by remittance or add money, is missing, late or credited wrongly.
notes: Hard, because the answer often lives in another system: the remittance backend is not mapped to any entity. RTL is involved for UAE funding.

label: Cards
description: The debit card is not visible, inactive, or fails for a payment.

label: Beneficiary
description: Adding, saving or paying a beneficiary fails, or money went to the wrong beneficiary.
signals: money sent to the wrong person
notes: Hard. One past case turned out to be misdirected money, so check for it and set misdirected_funds when it applies.

label: Account and balance view
description: Accounts, account details or the balance do not show correctly in the app.
notes: Medium. A balance is a point-in-time read and needs its taken_at.

label: UPI and third-party linking
description: UPI or a third-party app fails to link the account or does not deliver its OTP.
notes: Easy, with a known answer: the failing step is outside Aspora. Check the account state only, for example that the account is not frozen.

label: Fixed and term deposits
description: Booking a fixed or term deposit fails, or a booked deposit is not visible.
notes: Hard. Money may have moved, so check whether the deposit exists in CBS before answering.

label: Systemic or outage
description: Many users are affected at once by an outage, a bank-side change or a vendor failure.
signals: many users report the same error
notes: Hard and analytical: the work is aggregate counts across the fleet, not one customer's records.

label: Unknown
description: No other category fits, or the thread does not say enough to pick one.
notes: Use it rather than forcing a wrong category. Record what is missing in missing_info.
